review.identity: Late-fifties woman, silver-dominant low bun, narrow mature face, tired lower-lid folds, firm mouth, black soft neckline and old dull pin. Current card controls black clothing over old brown shawl.
review.v1: Initial substantive redraw read age and identity; large bright sclera, excessive fine silver ribbons and long collar-reaching tendrils remained. Raw positive side margins but right only 2px.
review.v2: Actual raw and 1x/8x inspected. Same face and low bun kept. Long dangling tendrils removed; silver masses broader, mouth and lower lids carry restrained resolve. Eye white materially reduced and neck slightly shorter. Broad mature nose/cheek planes remain.
review.remaining: Small light eye slivers, inward brow slopes and forehead marks still lend concern; do not claim every requested adjustment perfect. Hair is simplified but still more banded than a minimal 3-5-shape ideal. Right raw margin only 9px.
review.acceptance: Awaiting independent review; no native-pixel or runtime approval.

technical_method: Whole-canvas aspect-preserving NN, alpha threshold 128, MEDIANCUT <=32 colors without dither; no scripted facial, hair, clothes or geometry repainting.
